description: Far out-of-the-money 0DTE options bought at a fixed time and held (pre-registered 2026-10-31, before any run). Source: Option Alpha's Top Backtests (1.5M saved backtests; Moderate filter, last 30 days), whose top ranks are SPX/XSP 0DTE long puts at ~0.06-0.10 delta bought ~10:30 on calm up days ('0DTE Put Hedge': IV rank < 40, VIX not rising, day up, Wed-Fri, skip CPI/monthly expiration) and long calls at ~0.10 delta bought 11:00 on high-VIX days with negative dealer gamma ('Long Call Bounce': VIX >= 17, GEX < 0), both held to expiration with no exit. Those lists are the best of a huge number of user backtests, so their numbers are heavily selected. Here: SPY/QQQ/IWM pooled, 10:30 and 11:00 entries, calls and puts as separate runs, |delta| 0.03-0.12 (t 0.07) and 0.06-0.15 (t 0.10; bands wide enough for $1 strikes), held (a -95% stop, no target) until 15:50 (closest to expiration the desk allows) or 15:25, with no filter, the put-hedge PROXY filters (VIXY percentile <= 40%, VIXY not up > 1%, at or above the prior close, Wed-Fri, skip third Friday) and the call-bounce PROXY filters (VIXY percentile >= 60%, below the prior close, skip third Friday; GEX is not available, a down day stands in for it). Plus fixed take-profits of +300/+500/+1000% on the base 10:30 puts and 11:00 calls. Desk fills; the half-spread floor ($0.005) binds on these cheap options, so PF at 2x slippage is the key cost check. 54 runs.
